release_summary:
Public release 0.11.117 publishes the current full kit, hub and individual addon packages, LogNextChar, zMail and Global Bank for RoM 1.3.4. The updater can now compare against the same versions available from GitHub. Advanced AuctionHouse 6.2.6 and Addon LoadTimes 1.3.1 include refreshed package documentation; their patch versions preserve the immutable contents of the older published downloads. Private GlobalBankHelper data, character saves, mail, account files and backups are excluded from all packages.

Addon version and reload clarity (Global Bank 1.6.4, extension 1.3.4): the Addons page compares the hub against the release's hub_version, not the kit ZIP number, so a matching hub no longer appears outdated. The table says Latest release, and the page and popup explain that checks use published releases while Reload rereads files already installed on this PC. No permissions or private-data storage changes.

Included from the 0.11.116 development build:

Stats page fixes (Global Bank 1.6.3, extension 1.3.3): stat names and effects keep the colours from the game's saved tooltips, effects appear beside the name, and holders use their tooltip's class colours. Right-click a stat to exclude it; restore individual stats or all of them from the Excluded stats list. Exclusions stay in this Chrome profile. Private helper mail, tooltip, account-vault, terminal and backup files are blocked from Git/source exports and every release ZIP; Windows junctions are rejected as release inputs. Steam and Gameforge still share the same local data on the player's PC.

Validation: 1315 automated tests, 1289 passed and 26 existing skips, no failures. The isolated browser checks cover colours, inline effects, context-menu exclusions, persistence and restoration using fixture characters. All 17 install packages pass release checks; the 13 unchanged addon packages remain byte-identical. Native-client checks GS1 to GS5 remain in docs/TESTING.md.

Included from the 0.11.115 playtest:

New in that build: Steam support. The setup finds your Steam and Gameforge installs (or asks for the other one), keeps one Global Bank data folder, and puts the Chrome extension in the Gameforge copy; on Steam, ZShop's daily button skips Steam's browser, and Steam characters show as a Steam account in Global Bank. The guided setup (!setup_cherryskit.bat, at the root of the Full and Hub ZIPs) checks your addons against the Latest release and updates them with the old versions kept, offers anything missing that your addons can use, maps Interface\AddOns, moves older copies and retired folders into Interface\offloaded_addons (nothing is deleted), stops the Global Bank helper while it works, puts the login screen in place and walks through the Chrome extension. It runs from wherever the ZIP was extracted: it lists the Runes of Magic installs it finds, Steam or Gameforge, and asks which to set up, or takes a typed folder, or shows how to put the files in the game by hand. On a first setup it asks whether the kit uses Ultimate Mail Mod or zMail.

Cherry's Info 1.0 (/cinfo, /cq) replaces Cherry's Quests, pbInfo, TooltipIds, PortraitHP and Extended Macro Icons with one switch and one tabbed settings window; saved settings carry over. LogNextChar 1.3.3 includes Cherry's Loginxml - one ZIP with its login screen - and shows Arcane Transmutor charges on the character screen.

A new Global Bank page and popup (Global Bank 1.6.2, "Global Bank for RoM" extension 1.3.2, Chrome Web Store ready): grouped pages down the side, search and filters on top of the Bank, a who-holds-it panel, large, small or list layouts, mana stones and gear that stack when identical, tier, plus, HD and stack count in a slot's corners, #clean and #dirty mana stone search, quick filters such as #+1>, #t10> and #equipped=false, and #level>=100, #classes>3 or #dailytokens>5k on Characters, what each character wears in the Bank and in a character profile laid out like the game's, a Mail page with the mail waiting in each mailbox and the last 360 sent, a mailbox mark on the Gold overview when gold waits, a server picker, a stat's effects on hover as on a tier 6 mana stone, an Addons page that checks GitHub for updates, installs, offloads and deletes addons and switches the mailbox, a Gold overview that fits 200+ characters by Gameforge account, server and RoM account, a macro library and addon-settings backups with in-game Import, and a Terminal that runs inside the helper. The in-game window gains server tabs and a search that lights up the matching bag and bank slots.

Also in this build: zBag 5.07-ck20 (stat search, slot numbers on mouseover with a font size setting, #clean and #dirty mana stone search), Cherry's Chat 0.11.3 (Windows emoji panel entries join back together, /cchat bubbletest, cleaner trade lines), rom weakauras 0.9.33 (auras draw under bags, bank and other windows, with a Layer button; stack counts on buff and debuff templates), Ultimate Mail Mod 7.0.1-ck12 (mass send no longer skips items that never left their slot), zMail 1.4-ck1 as the other mailbox (pyrr's addon, distributed with permission, with a fix so gold it can't take at the cap stays unopened), and a lighter Cherry's Grid 1.1.6, with the Grid, Chat and zBag XML files at 105, 70 and 123 KB, down from 598, 401 and 229 KB, drawing the same frames. Everything from 0.11.114 is included.
runtime_validation: Lua 5.1 simulated-client suite: 1304 tests; 1278 passed and 26 retired-editor tests skipped, none failing. New tests run the guided setup through its real launcher the way a double-click does, stop and restart a hidden helper, update from a build folder (checksums, ZIP paths, kept player files, merged addons), install the dependencies picked, and cover hub-only installs, the installs the setup finds and the mailbox question, a ZIP extracted into a folder of its own, folders the manifest no longer loads, merged addons' origins, Cherry's Info's tabs, the shared XML templates, the macro library, backups and in-game Import with made-up macros, and zBag's stat search. The Global Bank page, popup and web Terminal were driven with real clicks and keys in a headless Chrome on made-up characters, also against the real helper and local host in a private folder, and the extension was loaded for real in a throwaway Chrome. The release build verifies all 17 install packages, 204 manifest entries and 47 Markdown files, and refuses players' macro and backup files. The update route ran against GitHub's Latest release in a throwaway folder, and from the previous build in a throwaway game folder. Nothing has been confirmed in the game client yet; docs/TESTING.md lists the checks. Addon packages whose code didn't change keep their versions; only the generated requirement lines in their READMEs changed.

addons.title: Cherry's KittyCombo
addons.summary: One-key priority combos, safer prediction and shared rotation codes.

works_with.for: use your auras as combo conditions
its code boxes use Cherry's Chat's copy-box size
click a party or raid frame to run a kitty
the Kitty mode shows on Cherry's Bar instead of its own plate

also: AddonManager lists it when you have that addon.

addons.title: rom weakauras
addons.summary: Custom buff, debuff, cooldown, cast and status displays.

works_with.for: triggers for KittyCombo's next skills and modes
mob information for triggers and the macro icon categories in its icon picker, and its quest tracker can use rom weakauras' fonts

origin.note: It's a rewrite of WeakAuras for World of Warcraft, so there's no original for this game.

addons.title: Cherry's Chat
addons.summary: Selectable chat, copying, emoji and chat display settings.

works_with.for: class colours for names, from Cherry's Info's player list
Ctrl+click a name in chat to fill the mail's To
KittyCombo's code boxes use the same copy-box size

addons.title: zBag
addons.summary: Bags, searching, sorting, quick sell and an All bags view.

works_with.for: a Global Bank button on the one-bag window
clicks in the bag work in the auction window

also: AddonManager lists it when you have that addon. BagSearch 1.21, BagSort 1.05b, PocketMaid and Sol are built in, so delete any separate `BagSearch` or `BagSort` folder. The quick-sell filter is based on Lootomatic, which is a separate addon and can stay.

addons.title: Global Bank
addons.summary: A searchable view of your characters' bags, banks and gold.

works_with.for: a Global Bank button on zBag's one-bag window
its searches fill the helper's auction cache
ZShop's daily reminder gets the real time from the Chrome extension or helper
Cherry's Bar's Clock gets the real time from the Chrome extension

the character screen shows each character's gold and last save, the server screen shows the helper's status, and its list of your account's characters boxes them together on the page and fills in their servers
the macro window's Import button brings in macros from the page's library, and the page shows its extra macro icons

addons.title: Ultimate Mail Mod
addons.summary: A modern mail window (inbox filters, mails that split as needed, inbox gold in compose, session activity) with the classic window one switch away, drag-box selection, shared recipients, gold presets and reliable mass sending.

works_with.for: Ctrl+click a name in chat to fill the mail's To
LogNextChar closes the mail window before switching characters

origin.name: Ultimate Mail Mod
origin.by: Shardea of Siochain, later Maxeem of Muinin, mvoigt, Jagodragon and Raihir

also: AddonManager lists it when you have that addon. Its libraries, LibStub and Sol, come with it.

addons.title: Advanced AuctionHouse
addons.summary: Auction searching, stat filters, history and a resizable window.

works_with.for: Global Bank's helper keeps a searchable cache of your auction searches
clicks in the bag work in the auction window

origin.name: Advanced AuctionHouse 6.0.2
origin.note: Its saved searches, price history and settings carry over to this version.

also: AddonManager lists it when you have that addon.

addons.title: Cherry's Addon LoadTimes
addons.summary: Troubleshooting: loading times and memory use, off until its Switch.txt turns it on.
also: It times every addon the game loads, kit or not, and needs none of them.

addons.title: ZShop
addons.summary: Item-shop access and a daily loyalty reward shortcut.

works_with.for: the daily reminder uses the real time, from Global Bank's Chrome extension or helper

addons.title: Cherry's Info
addons.summary: Quest tracker with Ctrl+click NPCs, richer tooltips with IDs, target portrait HP%, chat filters and 10,500+ macro icons.

works_with.for: rom weakauras' fonts for the quest tracker; its triggers and icon picker can use the mob information and macro icon categories from here
class colours in chat from its player list
the macro window's Import button lists its macro library

addons.title: Cherry's Grid
addons.summary: Party and raid frames, with KittyCombo actions on click.

works_with.for: run a kitty when you click a frame

origin.name: GridCliqueIt
origin.note: Cherry's Grid is new code that follows its design, and the two would draw the same raid frames.

addons.title: Cherry's Bar
addons.summary: Information bars at the top, bottom or both, with displays set per bar.

works_with.for: the Kitty mode display
the Clock shows the real time, from Global Bank's Chrome extension

also: Its Performance display times the update loops of other addons it finds, kit or not, including Lootomatic. It only reads their names, so none of them are needed.

standalone_packages.title: LogNextChar
standalone_packages.summary: Next and Prev buttons that log you straight into the neighbouring character, with its own login screen: gets past a stuck server list, saved logins, keyboard controls.

origin.note: Install login screen.bat, or the guided setup, moves those folders to `Interface\offloaded_addons` for you, along with `CherrysKit\CherrysLoginxmlHook` from before Cherry's Loginxml became part of this addon. The login screen itself is Rom Autologin by Pyrrhus with fixes, and has to live in `Interface\loginxml`, the only place the game reads one: the same installer updates what is there, copies the old folder to `Interface\offloaded_addons` first, and keeps your saved logins.

works_with.for: shows each character's gold and last save on the character screen and the helper's status on the server screen, and gives it your account's character list, which boxes them together on its page and fills in their servers
closes its window before switching characters, as it does the game's mail window

standalone_packages.after_install: close the game and run `!setup_cherryskit.bat`, or double-click `Interface\AddOns\CherrysKit\LogNextChar\Install login screen.bat`. The game only reads a login screen from `Interface\loginxml`, so this copies it there. Until then, Next and Prev only log you out.

external_packages.title: zMail
external_packages.summary: pyrr's mailbox addon, as an alternative to Ultimate Mail Mod. Its own folder Interface\AddOns\zmail, unchanged except one fix: mails with gold it can't take (gold cap) are no longer opened, so they keep their 30 days instead of 3.
external_packages.upstream: zMail 1.4 by pyrr (CurseForge). zMail is pyrr's project; Cherry's Kit has no connection with it other than distributing it, with pyrr's permission.
changes: src/inbox.lua: only read the attached item's count for mails without gold (data.money == 0), so mails with gold beyond the cap aren't opened.
data/chars.lua: shipped empty (the original listed test characters).
CHANGES.txt left out; CherrysKit-version.txt added so the setup can tell this copy from a CurseForge one.
